Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Shalini - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Meera - 10 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
4. Kunal - 10 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Meera stand near him.]

Ishaan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan dances to the music.]

Ishaan: "Okay, Mom."

[Ishaan sings a song.]

Shalini: "Meera, listen!"

[Ishaan waves goodbye to Mother.]

Shalini: "What happened?"

[Ishaan points at the sky.]

Ishaan: "I knew it!"

[Ishaan scratches his head.]

Meera: "Exactly right."

[Ishaan takes the bag from Mother.]

Ishaan (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

[Ishaan stands in the snow. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Ishaan: "That was fun!"

[Ishaan slides down the snowy slope.]

Ishaan (gently): "That was such a fun day!"
